key_takeaway: Users primarily rely on contextual and visual clues (people, events, objects) rather than structured calendar dates. Search failures most frequently manifest as System Retrieval Breakdowns (39.61%, 202 records) when the search engine fails to match semantic or face-recognition intent, forcing users into tedious manual scrolling without actionable refinement controls.
